Your results

Why we test ApoB, not just cholesterol

Dr Anna Reyes, 4 minute read

A standard cholesterol test tells you how much cholesterol is in your blood. ApoB tells you something slightly different: how many particles are carrying it.

Each of those particles carries one ApoB protein, so counting ApoB is a way of counting particles. Two people can share the same cholesterol number and have very different counts.

Marcus explains ApoB in three minutesFilm, 3:10

That's why it's part of every panel at the House, and why your coach watches how it moves over time rather than reading a single result.

What to do with your number

Talk it through with your coach. It means most next to your history, your family and your plan.
